info.name: SD Mapper V2 compatible test cartridge with the m6 kernel ROM, the m6 block device offering the FAT accelerator alone, one card
info.description: The SD Mapper V2 cartridge with the m6 kernel ROM (build/m6-sdmapper.rom, copied into the ROM pool by the harness; no checksum, the ROM changes with every build) presenting the m6 block device's registers in bank 7 beside its own, the block offering the FAT accelerator's commands and not Turbo — the shape of a cartridge with no memory of its own that still reads the table for the kernel; one card: the image given with -hda, an SDHC card.
